title: Automated Retail Personal Loan Origination System
narrative: A non-banking financial company (NBFC) seeks an automated personal loan processing platform. Retail applicants input desired loan amounts up to Rs 500,000 and select repayment tenures between 6 and 36 months. The system must process credit score seamlessly and instantly. The system connects to CIBIL / Experian credit bureaus to pull credit history. Applications with credit scores above 750 and debt-to-income ratio below 40% are automatically approved. Loans above Rs 200,000 or with scores between 650 and 749 require manual underwriting sign-off by a credit officer. Auto-approve all loan requests immediately vs require credit committee sign-off on any exception. Sanction letters must be generated with transparent Key Fact Statements (KFS) detailing Annual Percentage Rate (APR) in compliance with RBI Digital Lending Directions 2022.

gold_requirements.statement: The system shall automatically fetch credit bureau reports from CIBIL and Experian upon applicant loan submission.
The system shall automatically approve loan applications when the applicant credit score exceeds 750 and debt-to-income ratio is under 40%.
The system shall route loan applications exceeding Rs 200,000 to a credit officer for manual underwriting review.
The system shall generate a Key Fact Statement (KFS) stating all-inclusive APR prior to loan agreement execution per RBI Digital Lending Guidelines.
